As the lead training partner supporting Phillips Pharmaceuticals Uganda's introduction of DMPA-SC in pharmacies, drug shops and private clinics. While efforts have been made to strengthen private-sector engagement and reporting, many private providers continue to face challenges in capturing, managing, and routinely reporting family planning service data in a standardized and efficient manner.
